definitions.explanation: Able to withstand wear, pressure, or damage; not easily broken.
Having good health, not prone to illness.

notes:
{丈夫|じょうぶ} is a na-adjective meaning sturdy (for objects) or healthy (for people/bodies).

FORMS:
- Attributive: {丈夫|じょうぶ}な + noun
- Predicate: {丈夫|じょうぶ}だ/です
- Adverbial: {丈夫|じょうぶ}に ({丈夫|じょうぶ}に{育|そだ}つ — to grow up healthy)

SENSE 1 — STURDY/DURABLE (objects):
- {丈夫|じょうぶ}な{靴|くつ}: sturdy shoes
- {丈夫|じょうぶ}な{素材|そざい}: durable material
- {丈夫|じょうぶ}に{作|つく}る: to build solidly

SENSE 2 — HEALTHY/ROBUST (people, bodies):
- {体|からだ}が{丈夫|じょうぶ}: to be physically healthy
- {胃|い}が{丈夫|じょうぶ}: to have a strong stomach
- {丈夫|じょうぶ}に{育|そだ}つ: to grow up healthy

RELATED:
- {大丈夫|だいじょうぶ}: all right, okay (related but different meaning)
- {頑丈|がんじょう}: sturdy, solid (stronger emphasis on toughness)
- {健康|けんこう}: healthy (more clinical/general)
